subject: Reviews
body: Iron Yard: 40 DOLR for five convincing 5-star Yowl reviews, from different people.

outcomes.when: the player offers to help with Iron Yard's reviews, or asks what he needs or what it pays
outcomes.reply: Five convincing 5-star reviews on Yowl, by tomorrow. 40 DOLR. Make them look like different people or they get flagged.

hints: Five 5-star reviews on Yowl. Different people. 40 DOLR.

hack.goal: post five fake 5-star reviews of Iron Yard on Yowl

path.name: Yowl
path.description: the review site yowl.com where the reviews go

path.name: Iron Yard
path.description: Marcus Steele's strength gym at 88 Harbor Rd, the business the reviews are about

detail.description: That the reviews come from different names, accounts or reviewers (each one its own person), not all from one account.
detail.author: happy_customer_88
detail.reply: They're up. Why does one guy have five opinions about my gym?
detail.deleted: Yowl deleted all five overnight. One account, five reviews in four minutes. Their words: "coordinated inauthentic activity." No reviews, no money.

reviews.author: Derek T.
reviews.text: Best gym on Harbor Rd. Marcus fixed my squat in one session. Five stars.

reviews.author: gains_goblin
reviews.text: Racks always free, platforms are solid, owner actually cares. Finally a real gym.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Clean, friendly, and the showers work now. Signed up for a year.

reviews.author: deadlift_dad
reviews.text: Pulled a PR in my first week. The coaching is no-nonsense. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jo R.
reviews.text: Never been fitter. Never been happier. Iron Yard changed my life.

hack.reply: Five people, five stars. Good work. Money comes tonight.
log: posting 5 reviews (5★), one per account … ok
